forms.note: no <form> elements on the site; data-entry UIs use button-driven flows (admin manager, leaderboard modal)

env.methodology: Headless Chrome 1366x900/390x844 etc, localhost static server, fresh profile per run, ACTIVE error/network capture (P32-TOOL-001 fix), interaction = real DOM clicks/inputs/Enter keys + state assertions. A feature is WORKING only when interaction + expected UI state + 0 console errors + 0 unexpected network failures.
